name: UART Mux
description: The `uart_mux` component lets one hardware UART be used either by a [CDC-ACM UART Bridge](https://esphome.io/components/bridge/cdc_acm_uart/) or by other components on the device, switching between the two at runtime. A typical use is a device with a radio module on its UART: while a computer is connected over USB the module is exposed to it as a serial port, and when no computer is connected the device's own firmware talks to the module instead.

config_entries.label: Bridge ID
config_entries.description: The [CDC-ACM UART Bridge](https://esphome.io/components/bridge/cdc_acm_uart/) whose UART is shared. The mux takes the UART from the bridge, so it is not configured here.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this component.

config_entries.label: Initial Route
config_entries.description: Who gets the UART at boot: `bridge` or `local`. Defaults to `bridge`. See [Following a USB host](https://esphome.io/components/uart_mux/#following-a-usb-host) for when to use `local`.
